subject: Request: Keep pilot live while procurement completes
messages:
From: Sara Lang <sara.lang@ellison.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Barnes <tim.barnes@ellison.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot continuity ask — procurement still working on PO

Hi Vivek,

Quick update from our side: procurement has approved vendor selection but legal and finance are still finalizing the PO routing. They estimate another 7–10 business days before a signed PO is in place. We’ve been running a small pilot of Redwood in our sandbox and the team is midway through an integration that proves out latency and cost. If the pilot access lapses while procurement finishes paperwork, we’ll lose momentum and a handful of engineering hours.

Is there any flexibility to keep our sandbox access running or provide a small bridging credit while PO is processed? We’re not asking for extended discounted pricing — just enough runway to finish the evaluation and hand off to our platform team. Attached: a short one-pager of the remaining scope and a screenshot from procurement showing the PO queue status.

Appreciate any help — happy to jump on a quick call if it helps.

Best,
Sara Lang
Head of Data Integrations
Ellison Health

(Attachment: Ellison_Pilot_Requirements.pdf, PO_status_screenshot.png)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lang <sara.lang@ellison.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity ask — procurement still working on PO

Sara — thanks for the clear update and for sharing the attachments. I routed this internally to get a quick decision. Short answer: we can offer a short, targeted runway to preserve the pilot while procurement completes.

Proposed approach:
- Provide a one-week sandbox credit bundle (30k tokens equivalent) tied to your trial workspace to keep engineers running tests.
- Credits are conditional on continued engagement (weekly sync) and confirmation of the PO timeline.
- If PO executes before credits are exhausted we’ll convert the pilot to a paid Dedicated evaluation with normal billing.

I’ll coordinate approvals internally and confirm by EOD tomorrow. If that works, Tim — I’ll add a one-line note we can share with procurement/legal to speed signoff.

— Vivek
Director, Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: short bridging credit for Ellison (DEAL-7892) — need ok from promotions & finance

Marissa / Olga — copying the thread with Ellison. Procurement stalled but this is a high-fit pilot (platform + latency test). Customer is asking for a very small sandbox runway to avoid losing momentum. Details: one-week, 30k-token credit to preserve integration work.

Considerations:
- Approval path: promotions signoff + finance note (non-refundable credit)
- Precedent: similar to past short-run runway offers but limited to token bundle and conditional on PO timeline
- Metrics: we should require a quick weekly sync and a short success checklist (integration test green + sample latency report) to track progress

Questions:
1) Marissa — are you comfortable approving as a promotions exception? If yes, I’ll mark it as a one-off with recorded reason in the CRM.
2) Olga — can finance accept a non-refundable credit and annotate the invoice once PO arrives?

If you’re ok I’ll send a formal offer to Sara today.

Thanks,
Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: short bridging credit for Ellison (DEAL-7892) — need ok from promotions & finance

Vivek / Olga — quick thumbs up from me. This is low-dollar, high-velocity and directly tied to a PO that’s already in legal. Approvals: promotions OK for a one-week, 30k-token bundle as a non-recurring credit.

Olga — please confirm whether finance is fine with applying the credit and later reconciling once the PO is received. If you can mark this as an exception and add a note to the deal in HubSpot, I’ll send the customer-facing confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sara Lang <sara.lang@ellison.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot continuity ask — procurement still working on PO

Sara / team — finance confirms we can apply a one-week, 30k-token non-refundable sandbox credit to the Ellison trial workspace. Conditions: PO must be submitted within 14 calendar days and we need a short weekly check-in with the engineering sponsor. I’ve added a note to DEAL-7892 in HubSpot and attached a brief credit memo to the deal record (link copied below).

Sara — we’ll enable the credit within the hour; please confirm the workspace ID you want it applied to and we’ll track usage. Happy to set a standing 15-min sync early next week to keep things moving.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

(Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7892 , https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EllisonPilot)
